== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on English [[Sandcrawler (Dark)]] and [[Sandcrawler (Dark) (PC Errata)]]. Columns are Original and PC Errata (Appendix A) only. [[Sandcrawler (Dark) (Errata)]] was a same-words Holotable remaster of the print and is folded into the original. Do not mix [[Sandcrawler]] (Light). Do not add Unlimited, Japanese, foil, or (V) columns. {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words that changed. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
